vacancy.title: End-to-End Navigation System Engineer (2 Posts)
vacancy.assessment: New ESA ESTEC A2-A4 position (two posts) in Navigation Systems Implementation and Validation, working on Galileo, Celeste LEO-PNT and OpStar. Covers system-level AIT/AIV, laboratory testbeds, test campaigns, hardware-in-the-loop verification, technical reviews and nonconformance resolution. Relevant generalist engineering/test overlap and direct ESA access, but the required four years of relevant PNT/GNSS systems experience, Galileo signal/receiver expertise and telecom engineering background make this a specialist stretch. Published 26 October 2026; deadline 16 November 2026. Vacancy and ATS requisition independently corroborated by current job syndication; canonical ESA URL is based on official requisition path and not yet fetchable by web indexing.
